profile: Rigel Pharmaceuticals develops and commercializes therapies for hematologic disorders and cancer. Its marketed medicines include TAVALISSE for chronic immune thrombocytopenia, REZLIDHIA for certain acute myeloid leukemia, GAVRETO for RET-driven lung and thyroid cancers, and VEPPANU (vepdegestrant) for specified advanced breast cancer. Rigel also develops clinical candidates, including R289 for myelodysplastic syndromes, and works with pharmaceutical partners on commercialization.
